items.name: Climatic characterization of the sites in Argentina (Córdoba y Santiago del Estero)
items.description: Dateset contains past and future exploration on climate in Chancaní, Córdoba and Copo, Santiago del Estero, Argentina. The described variables were proposed by the climatologist, biologist and agronomic engineers and up -dated with the information obtained after the stakeholders workshop.

items.name: Replication Data for: Financial stability in response to climate change in a northern temperate economy - Climate Projections
items.description: The monthly and provincial climate projections from the MARS model. Data projections are also divided into climate normals. Data is provided in trade and combined GDP values.

items.name: Replication Data for: Financial stability in response to climate change in a northern temperate economy - Binned Canadian Climate Data
items.description: Binned Canadian Climate Data. Data is binned in two degree increments for every province. Data is aggregated from 2000 - 2019.

items.name: Replication Data for: Financial stability in response to climate change in a northern temperate economy - Select Monthly Canadian Climate Data
items.description: Select monthly climate data for provinces in Canada. Monthly data includes mean temperature, maximum temperatures, minimum temperature, snow, precipitation, HDD, CDD, and Trade.
